modules.build: Back icon; title 'CIA.'; top-right 'voice on' status label with mic icon lit active orange #FF5E00 (TopBar otherwise unchanged from CIA Chat [09]).

Compressed chat history. CIA bubble: 'What would help right now?'. User DraftTranscriptionBubble (glass-frost) streams draft text: '[draft voice transcript...]', paired with ChipProvenance 'via OS speech-to-text'.

Glass-frost keyboard-replacement panel (white 4.5% fill, border white 8%, r24-28). Overline: 'listening.'. belowFold.build: First-use voice permission and transcript-handling modal. Data category: microphone and transcript. Source: device microphone/OS speech-to-text. Scope: sending text to CIA. Retention: transcript in *chat* history until deletion. Exposes export, revoke mic, and delete transcript. Notes raw audio is not stored.

imageSlots.prompt: CIA voice in chat avatar or social proof placeholders, Balencia warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text.

trustControls: CIA voice in chat keeps privacy-first language and SafetyResourceCard reachable for journal, mood, stress, sleep, energy, voice, and wellbeing-adjacent moments.
Audience, visibility, report, mute, block, and own-content delete controls exposed before sharing or social comparison.
Every CIA evidence chip explains why the source was used, marks low-confidence synthesis, and deletes recommendation history.
Source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete.
notes: Default: panel slides up, waveform idle, status says 'listening.'
Skeleton: audio-engine boot shows panel geometry and static waveform placeholders for under 500ms.
Empty: no speech after 8 seconds auto-cancels and shows a silence toast.
Error: permission denied, transcription failed, network lost, and max-duration reached are separate states with retry/cancel.
Success: transcript solidifies into a sent user bubble, --glow-done flashes, CIA thinking indicator appears.
Disabled: BtnPrimary 'send' dimmed when transcript is empty, offline, or permission-blocked.
Offline: partial transcript stays local; send disabled until connection returns or text can be copied.
Reduced-motion: panel appears instantly, waveform becomes static level bars, draft updates by whole phrases.
Accessibility: status, draft, and controls clear AA+ against panel frost and warm dark; transcript updates in a polite live region.

Italic word 'chat' (declared in Visual System) doesn't appear literally in the primary ASCII composition; applied instead to the ConsentCard's retention line ('transcript in *chat* history until deletion'), sourced from Data Honesty — no other on-screen literal copy contains the word.
